Game Overview

At its heart, Deep Fuel is a mining game about descend into the depths with your drill, collecting precious treasures while managing limited fuel. Strategize your path and snag fuel pickups to venture deeper each time. Balancing quick reflexes and resource management, Deep Fuel challenges your skills as you aim to break your personal records. How far will you go?
